content: d If a PortInterfaceMapping is specified at the Delega- tionSwConnector of a R-port, the RTE of the receiving ECU shall perform the con- version of the VariableDataPrototype s or ArgumentDataPrototype s that is re- ceived over a communication bus from the representation specified by the outerPort to the representation specified by the innerPort . In this case [SWS_Rte_03816] shall not be applied.
